summary: A user received a fake IRS notice directing them to register for a purported DACP program through a QR code. After scanning the code the user received a call from someone impersonating Coinbase who provided a twelve word recovery phrase.
user_mistake: scanned a QR code from an unverified tax notice
prevention: Confirm tax notices through official IRS channels before scanning QR codes / End calls from unsolicited Coinbase representatives and contact support through the official application
